title_as_printed: Experimental Densities rho and Mean Apparent Molar Volumes V_phi of Aqueous Solutions of NaCl and CaCl2 at Ionic Strength I and Ionic Fraction yB

footnotes_as_printed.a: The datum masked by an asterisk was excluded from the final fit. (asterisk on V_phi 25.035 at 308 K, yB = 0.8860, I = 6.1709)

pressure_note: 0.1 MPa (title); measured with a vibrating-tube densimeter, no further statement on pressure

value2.what: mean apparent molar volume, calculated by the authors from the measured density (eq 3)

composition.other_species: NaCl and CaCl2 mixtures; ionic strength fraction yB = 3m(CaCl2)/(3m(CaCl2)+m(NaCl)) given in label rows (yB=0 pure NaCl, yB=1 pure CaCl2); I is in mol per kg of water (molality scale, paper writes mol.kg-1; the word water is not used explicitly)

skip_rows.reason: block labels (temperature heading with ionic fraction yB)

conversion_needs: ionic strength I and yB to molalities: m_CaCl2 = yB*I/3, m_NaCl = (1-yB)*I (from the definition of yB, I = m_NaCl + 3 m_CaCl2)
notes: Printed layout is two side-by-side column blocks per yB block; stacked left block first then right block. Blocks are headed 298 K (rows 0-122) and 308 K (rows 123-end); the label-row text carries the nominal temperature and yB. Each row's measured T is in the T column. The 308 K asterisk is moved to the note column. Densities printed with a thin space between digit groups (e.g. 1.174 149) written without the space. Table II (fit parameters) not extracted.
